name: Git (reference server)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C10; partly meets C5, C8, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The PyPI record for mcp-server-git 2026.11.11 links the repository, and PyPI holds a provenance attestation for the release naming `modelcontextprotocol/servers` (workflow `release.yml`) as publisher.

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 2026.11.11 is dated 2026-11-11; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-11; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-12.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 7 advisories are published in the repository's advisory list for mcp-server-git; each names a patched version at or below the latest release (2026.11.11). Most recent: GHSA-6hqx-gqrx-c5r2 (high, published 2026-11-11, patched in 2026.11.11).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Tools that change a repository are available by default; `--repository` confines the server to one repository. Quoted: “**Without `--repository`, the server reads and writes any Git repository the server process can reach.**”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The documented setup takes no credential; the README notes that credentials embedded in remote addresses are redacted from tool output. Quoted: “A credential embedded in a URL is never returned”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `src/git/README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README describes a control for configuration and hooks carried inside a repository; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content. Quoted: “so the server never runs a program they name, with or without `--repository`”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: mcp<3,>=2.3. Lower-bound version 2.3.0 of mcp (PyPI) was published on 2026-10-02, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
